content: The Diabetes Control and Complications Trial (DCCT) highlights the critical importance of reducing hyperglycemia to prevent complications and achieve glucose levels that are as close to normal as possible. Advanced technologies, including continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), insulin pumps, and automated insulin delivery (AID) systems, have significantly contributed to making this goal achievable for many adolescents. Additionally, enhanced patient education has played a pivotal role in supporting effective diabetes management in this population.
